purpose: Second over-acquisition wave. Prioritises independently measured process, quality, material-batch, multi-material and recycled-material evidence beyond immediate app needs.

sources.name: EPP foam-moulding raw experimental AutoML dataset
sources.notes: Article is CC BY and explicitly publishes the raw experimental dataset on GitHub; repository has no explicit LICENSE file, so raw-file redistribution remains rights-review rather than assumed.

sources.name: Pressure-controlled recycled-HDPE injection moulding experiment
sources.notes: Independent recycled-HDPE family distinct from RWTH recycled PP. Open manuscript also available through OSTI.

sources.name: Predictive quality control of rubber injection moulding
sources.scale: 649 production cycles; 118 unique parameter combinations; three material batches with different viscosities
sources.notes: Unique setpoint combinations are separated across train/test/validation, making this unusually useful for leakage-safe batch-drift validation. Raw downloadable dataset not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Three-colour co-injection + overmoulding automotive process
sources.verifiedOutcome: Initial simulated maximum warpage 1.743 mm; actual measured production result 0.477 mm after cooling/system redesign.
sources.notes: Data are confidential but available on reasonable request; strong acquisition target for multi-material/hot-runner actual behaviour.

sources.name: PP / coconut-fibre composite multicomponent adhesion experiment
sources.material: Braskem EP 440 L PP + 30% coconut-fibre PP composite
sources.scale: 16 factorial treatments; eight moulded specimens per condition
sources.notes: Arburg Allrounder 370 S two-component process. Data available on request.

sources.name: Micro-scale CFD foam-injection-moulding data/materials repository target
sources.notes: 2026 CC BY study; data and materials are stated to be available through the repository/request route. Keep simulation and physical validation data separated during ingestion.

sources.name: Injection-moulded PE/PCRPE blend property dataset
sources.notes: Data in Brief open dataset produced from injection-moulded samples; strong material/recyclate breadth with explicit Creative Commons publication.

sources.name: Direct injection-moulded PA66-GF35 / high-strength-steel hybrid experiment
sources.notes: Independent polymer-metal hybrid process/failure family; article raw data not confirmed open.

sources.name: Thermo-mechanical recycling of post-consumer film-grade rLDPE with injection-moulded characterisation
sources.material: Green Isotene recycled LDPE with reported ~5% PP contamination
sources.notes: Adds contaminated film-stream recycling and reprocessing-history evidence distinct from bottle-derived recycled HDPE/PP families.
